digest.component_or_area: build-provenance semantics and artifact verification workflows
propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export 3,019 files although production hook consumes only three, causing redundant setup across xdist workers
Artifact-probe workflow builds with trusted-main GITHUB_SHA instead of patchset HEAD, accepting wrong but nonempty COMMIT and violating exact-source identity
Xdist session fixture initializes independently on all three workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup despite only one build being necessary
Live run 31874837464 received patchset 9aecb53e but artifact-probe built with GITHUB_SHA 7d908fb, passing truthiness-only probes with incorrect provenance
Minimal committed package with production hook preserved exact fallback SHA while reducing paired build totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s
Workflow consumers must derive git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and require exact equality for wheel and sdist artifacts
